# Ablation tables (generated by dev/ablation_table.py)

Train is split by schema into discovery (71 DBs, 292 tasks) and holdout (47 DBs, 188 tasks).
All numbers are official three-instance correctness from mp3_sql.score.

## A1. Final-stage convention rewrites (no LLM)

| configuration | discovery | holdout | validation | mean tool calls |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v1 (inherited rule controller) | 252/292 | 160/188 | 111/120 | 4.05 |
| + join pruning | 254/292 (+2) | 160/188 (+0) | 112/120 (+1) | 4.08 |
| + join pruning + semi-join (= v2 without LLM) | 255/292 (+3) | 160/188 (+0) | 112/120 (+1) | 4.08 |

## A2. LLM proposer (dev adapter trained on discovery only; difference vs v2 without LLM)

Discovery numbers are in-sample for the adapter and are shown for completeness only.

| configuration | discovery | holdout | validation | mean tool calls |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| v2 without LLM | 255/292 | 160/188 | 112/120 | 4.08 |
| LLM only after v1 finishes (no reserve) | 258/292 (+3) | 161/188 (+1) | 112/120 (+0) | 4.09 |
| reserve K=2, draft-first, static schema filter (chosen) | 266/292 (+11) | 162/188 (+2) | 112/120 (+0) | 4.07 |
| reserve K=3, draft-first, static schema filter | 266/292 (+11) | 162/188 (+2) | 112/120 (+0) | 4.04 |

*harmful = v2 without LLM is correct, the LLM SQL matches the public example but is wrong on another instance (i.e. it would be accepted by a public-example check and lose the task).
